# SalesRobot

SalesRobot automates LinkedIn outreach, campaign management, prospecting, messaging, and AI-personalized sales workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/salesrobot/.

## Actions

- **Add Prospect to Campaign**: Add one identified LinkedIn prospect to a SalesRobot campaign.
- **Get LinkedIn Profile** (read-only): Retrieve a LinkedIn person or company profile through a connected SalesRobot LinkedIn account.
- **Get Prospect Sequence Status** (read-only): Get sequence-step execution and message status for one prospect, optionally within a campaign.
- **List Campaign Prospects** (read-only): List and filter prospects for a campaign or across campaigns on one connected LinkedIn account.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): List and filter campaigns for one connected LinkedIn account, returning campaign UUIDs for prospect and status workflows.
- **List Inbox Threads** (read-only): List and filter synchronized SalesRobot inbox threads for one connected LinkedIn account.
- **List LinkedIn Accounts** (read-only): List LinkedIn accounts connected to SalesRobot and return the account UUIDs required by most other tools.
- **List LinkedIn Posts** (read-only): List recent posts for a LinkedIn person or company through a connected SalesRobot LinkedIn account.
- **Send Message**: Send one message in an existing SalesRobot LinkedIn conversation.
- **Update Prospect**: Update profile, contact, and custom field data for one existing SalesRobot prospect.
